raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Reject the ViT-only `TORCH_SDPA` sentinel from every decoder backend configuration path: direct `AttentionConfig` construction, per-KV-group overrides, and the top-level CLI/Python `attention_backend` shorthand. This fixes #64954 while keeping `TORCH_SDPA` available for multi-modal encoder attention.

No open PR addresses this issue or the same configuration validation gap.

## Claims

- Invalid decoder configurations now fail during config creation
- Global, per-kind, CLI, Python engine argument, and public `LLM` paths receive the same validation
- String and enum inputs receive the same validation
- `auto`, valid decoder backends, and the existing mutually exclusive check remain unchanged
- Multi-modal encoder configurations can still select `TORCH_SDPA`

## Validation

Before the entry-point fix at `b043b3a12`, the new real `EngineArgs.create_engine_config()` regression failed for both Python and CLI inputs:

```text
FAILED ...[python] - Failed: DID NOT RAISE ValueError
FAILED ...[cli] - Failed: DID NOT RAISE ValueError
2 failed
```

The public `LLM` regression also continued past configuration into EngineCore startup instead of raising the expected validation error:

```text
FAILED tests/entrypoints/llm/test_generate.py::test_rejects_torch_sdpa_for_decoder
RuntimeError: Engine core initialization failed
```

After the fix:

```text
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  --confcutdir=tests/engine \
  tests/engine/test_arg_utils.py::test_attention_config \
  tests/engine/test_arg_utils.py::test_attention_backend_rejects_torch_sdpa -q
3 passed
```

```text
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/entrypoints/llm/test_generate.py::test_rejects_torch_sdpa_for_decoder -q
1 passed
```

```text
PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  --confcutdir=tests/v1/attention \
  tests/v1/attention/test_backend_per_kind.py -q
19 passed
```

```text
PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  --confcutdir=tests/config \
  tests/config/test_multimodal_config.py::test_mm_encoder_attn_backend_str_conversion \
  tests/config/test_multimodal_config.py::test_mm_encoder_attn_backend_invalid -q
3 passed
```

```text
.venv/bin/pre-commit run --files \
  vllm/engine/arg_utils.py \
  tests/engine/test_arg_utils.py \
  tests/entrypoints/llm/test_generate.py
All applicable hooks passed, including ruff, mypy, test tethering, and config validation.
```

Model evaluation: not applicable; this change rejects an unsupported configuration before model loading and does not affect outputs from supported configurations.

## Details

`TORCH_SDPA` is an enum sentinel used by the multi-modal encoder path and has no decoder backend class. `AttentionConfig.__post_init__` now validates the final global and per-kind decoder backends after parsing.

The top-level `attention_backend` shorthand previously deep-copied an already constructed `AttentionConfig` and then assigned `backend` directly. Pydantic assignment validation is not enabled for vLLM config dataclasses, so that assignment did not rerun `__post_init__`. The shorthand now uses vLLM's Pydantic-compatible `replace()` helper to reconstruct the copied config, preserving its other fields while rerunning parsing and final validation.

The existing direct/per-kind tests cover string and enum inputs. The engine-argument regression exercises both a Python enum and the real CLI parser through `EngineArgs.create_engine_config()`, while the public-entry regression constructs `LLM` through `vllm_runner`. Existing tests continue to cover valid shorthand values, `auto`, dot notation, the mutually exclusive shorthand/config check, and the separate multi-modal encoder path. The field docstring documents the decoder/encoder distinction in generated config and CLI reference material.

This change was developed with AI assistance and reviewed and validated by the submitter.

Follow-up after tracing the top-level `attention_backend` path: `EngineArgs.create_engine_config()` was assigning the shorthand value to an already constructed `AttentionConfig`, so the final `__post_init__` validation was not rerun.

Commit b043b3a12 switches that override to the existing Pydantic-compatible `replace()` helper and adds real Python and CLI entry-point regressions through `create_engine_config()`. The existing valid backend, `auto`, mutual-exclusion, direct/per-kind, and multi-modal encoder tests also pass. I updated the PR description with the commands and results.

On the pre-fix parent `bc08a6165`, the same test continued into EngineCore startup and failed there instead of raising the expected config error. It passes on the current branch, and pre-commit (including test tethering) confirms the test is included in the Entrypoints Integration suite. The PR description now includes both results.

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.
